source_title: Is Moving From Gumroad A Smart Idea 3D4C1A3D4B
source_date_if_available: Accessed April 2026; post undated (context suggests early-to-mid 2023)
snippet_primary: "All your marketing was linked to the gumroad page. That means you need to update all those links. But do you honestly know and control where those links are? I don't think you will. There will be people mentioning it in Reddit comments, reddit posts, IH comments, Hacker News comments, slack messages... Changing to a competitor is probably going to result in lost sales if you've got any decent traction in social media."
